title.zh: 卷395 列傳一百八十二 常大淳 双福 王锦绣 常禄 王寿同 蒋文庆 陶恩培 多山 吉尔杭阿 刘存厚 绷阔 周兆熊 罗遵殿 王友端 缪梓 徐有壬 王有龄
title.en: Volume 395 Biographies 182: Chang Dachun, Shuang Fu, Wang Jinxiu, Chang Lu, Wang Shoutong, Jiang Wenqing, Tao Enpei, Duo Shan, Ji Erhanga, Liu Cunhou, Beng Kuo, Zhou Zhaoxiong, Luo Zundian, Wang Youduan, Mou Zi, Xu Youren, Wang Youling
title.raw: 卷395 列傳一百八十二 常大淳 双福 王锦绣 常禄 王寿同 蒋文庆 陶恩培 多山 吉尔杭阿 刘存厚 绷阔 周兆熊 罗遵殿 王友端 缪梓 徐有壬 王有龄

sentences.zh: =常大淳=常大淳，字蘭陔，湖南衡陽人。

translations.literal: Chang Dachun: Chang Dachun, courtesy name Lan'ai, a native of Hengyang in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Dachun, courtesy name Lan'ai, was a native of Hengyang in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 道光三年進士，選庶吉士，授編修，遷御史。

translations.literal: In the third year of Daoguang he passed the jinshi examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, appointed compiler, and promoted to censor.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the third year of the Daoguang reign (1823), entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, was appointed compiler, and was later promoted to censor.

sentences.zh: 湖南鎮筸兵變，戕營官，鎮道莫敢誰何，大淳疏劾之。

translations.literal: At Zhenqian in Hunan the garrison troops mutinied and killed their camp officers; the commander and circuit intendant dared take no action, and Dachun memorialized to impeach them.
translations.idiomatic: When the garrison at Zhenqian in Hunan mutinied and killed their camp officers, the territorial commander and circuit intendant did not dare confront them; Dachun submitted a memorial impeaching them.

sentences.zh: 出為福建督糧道，署按察使。

translations.literal: He went out to serve as grain intendant of Fujian and acted as provincial judicial commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed grain intendant of Fujian and served concurrently as acting provincial judicial commissioner.

sentences.zh: 晉江縣獲洋盜三百八十餘人，總督欲駢誅之，大淳力爭，全活脅從者近三百人。

translations.literal: Jinjiang County captured more than three hundred eighty foreign pirates; the governor-general wished to execute them all together, but Dachun argued strenuously and thereby fully spared nearly three hundred coerced followers.
translations.idiomatic: When Jinjiang County seized more than three hundred eighty foreign pirates, the governor-general wanted them all executed at once; Dachun argued strenuously and saved nearly three hundred who had been coerced into joining.

sentences.zh: 司獄囚滿，大淳曰：「囚不皆死罪，獄無隙地，疫作且死。」

translations.literal: When the prison cells were full, Dachun said: "The prisoners are not all condemned to death; the jail has no empty space, and if plague breaks out they will all die."
translations.idiomatic: When the prisons were overcrowded, Dachun said, "Not every prisoner is under sentence of death; the cells have no room left, and if plague breaks out they will all perish."

sentences.zh: 乃分別定擬遣釋，囹圄一清。

translations.literal: He then fixed sentences separately, releasing and deporting many, and the prisons were wholly cleared.
translations.idiomatic: He then reviewed cases individually, arranging releases and deportations until the prisons were entirely cleared.

sentences.zh: 歷浙江鹽運使、安徽按察使。

translations.literal: He served in succession as salt transport commissioner of Zhejiang and provincial judicial commissioner of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: He later served as salt transport commissioner of Zhejiang and provincial judicial commissioner of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 母憂歸，服闋，授湖北按察使，遷陝西、湖北布政使。

translations.literal: Upon his mother's death he returned home to observe mourning; when the mourning period ended he was appointed provincial judicial commissioner of Hubei and promoted to provincial treasurer of Shaanxi and Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: After his mother's death he returned home to observe mourning; when the mourning period ended he was appointed provincial judicial commissioner of Hubei and later served as provincial treasurer of Shaanxi and Hubei.

sentences.zh: 三十年，擢浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year he was promoted to governor of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year of Daoguang (1850) he was promoted to governor of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，海盜布興肆擾，疏劾黃岩、溫州、乍浦三鎮總兵應調遲延，親赴寧波，與提督會剿，降其渠，凡五月事定。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng pirates led by Bu Xing ran riot; he memorialized to impeach the three regional commanders of Huangyan, Wenzhou, and Zhapu for delaying when called to duty, went in person to Ningbo, joined the provincial military commander in a joint suppression, induced their chieftain to surrender, and within five months the affair was settled.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Xianfeng reign (1851), pirates under Bu Xing spread disorder along the coast; Dachun memorialized against the regional commanders of Huangyan, Wenzhou, and Zhapu for tardy mobilization, went personally to Ningbo, coordinated a joint campaign with the provincial military commander, induced the rebel leader to surrender, and within five months the disturbance was settled.

sentences.zh: 二年，調湖北。

translations.literal: In the second year he was transferred to Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianfeng (1852) he was transferred to Hubei.

sentences.zh: 粵匪犯長沙，土匪蜂起，或議停文武鄉試，大淳不可，終事無譁。

translations.literal: Cantonese rebels attacked Changsha and local bandits rose everywhere; some proposed suspending the civil and military provincial examinations, but Dachun would not agree, and in the end the examinations passed without disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: When Cantonese rebels threatened Changsha and local bandits rose in numbers, some proposed canceling the provincial civil and military examinations; Dachun refused, and the examinations were held without incident.

sentences.zh: 尋調山西，未行，時總督程矞採駐防湖南，失機獲罪，徐廣縉代之，駐湖南督師，而賊勢益張。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Shanxi but had not yet departed; at that time Governor-General Cheng Yucai was stationed in Hunan on defensive duty, lost his opportunity through fault and was punished, Xu Guangjin replaced him and remained in Hunan directing the army, while the rebels grew ever stronger.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to Shanxi but had not yet left when Governor-General Cheng Yucai, stationed in Hunan on defensive duty, was punished for missing his chance; Xu Guangjin replaced him and took command in Hunan while rebel strength continued to grow.

sentences.zh: 兩湖集兵長沙，防岳州者僅千人，大淳奏調陝甘兵未至，岳州土匪王萬里等踞桃林，檄防兵討之，萬里遁，而粵匪己走寧鄉，破益陽，出臨資口。

translations.literal: The two Hu provinces concentrated troops at Changsha; those defending Yuezhou numbered only a thousand men; Dachun memorialized that the Shaanxi-Gansu troops he had requested had not yet arrived; bandits of Yuezhou such as Wang Wanli occupied Taolin; he ordered the defending troops to attack them and Wanli fled, but the Cantonese rebels had already marched through Ningxiang, taken Yiyang, and emerged at Linzikou.
translations.idiomatic: Forces from Hunan and Hubei were massed at Changsha, yet only a thousand men guarded Yuezhou; Dachun reported that the Shaanxi-Gansu troops he had requested had not arrived; Yuezhou bandits led by Wang Wanli held Taolin until he ordered the garrison to attack and Wanli fled—but the Cantonese rebels had already passed through Ningxiang, seized Yiyang, and advanced toward Linzikou.

sentences.zh: 先是，大淳檄巴陵紳士吳士邁練漁勇防水路，扼土星港設柵，千人守之，商賈民船萬餘，皆阻柵不得行。

translations.literal: Earlier, Dachun ordered the Baling gentry Wu Shimai to train fishing-boat militia to guard the waterways, blocked the Tuxing Harbor with a barrier, and stationed a thousand men to hold it; more than ten thousand merchant and civilian boats were all stopped at the barrier and could not pass.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Dachun had instructed the Baling gentleman Wu Shimai to train fishing-boat militia to defend the waterways; they blocked Tuxing Harbor with a barrier manned by a thousand men, and more than ten thousand merchant and civilian vessels were held up and could not pass.

sentences.zh: 及賊至，漁勇潰，船悉為賊有，水陸並下。

translations.literal: When the rebels arrived the fishing militia collapsed; all the boats fell into rebel hands, and they advanced by land and water together.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels arrived the fishing militia broke and fled; the rebels seized every boat and pressed forward by land and water together.

sentences.zh: 提督博勒恭武守岳州，不戰而走，城遂陷。

translations.literal: Provincial Military Commander Bole Gongwu defended Yuezhou but fled without fighting, and the city then fell.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial Military Commander Bole Gongwu held Yuezhou but retreated without a fight, and the city fell.

sentences.zh: 武漢大震，兵不滿五千，奏留江南提督雙福募勇繕城為守禦計，而兩司以下亦少應變才。

translations.literal: Wuhan was greatly shaken; the troops numbered fewer than five thousand; he memorialized to retain Jiangnan Provincial Military Commander Shuang Fu to recruit braves and repair the walls as a plan for defense, yet among the two commissioners and those below there were few with talent for meeting emergencies.
translations.idiomatic: Panic spread through Wuhan; the garrison numbered fewer than five thousand; Dachun memorialized to keep Jiangnan Military Commander Shuang Fu to recruit militia and repair the walls for defense, yet among the provincial commissioners and subordinates few showed talent for crisis management.

sentences.zh: 大淳性仁柔，但以好語拊循士卒，莫能得其死力。

translations.literal: Dachun was by nature gentle and mild; he could only comfort the troops with kind words and could not win their utmost devotion unto death.
translations.idiomatic: Dachun was gentle by nature and could only soothe the troops with kind words; he could not win their willingness to die for him.

sentences.zh: 賊至，先陷漢陽，作浮橋攻武昌。

translations.literal: When the rebels arrived they first took Hanyang, built a pontoon bridge, and attacked Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels arrived they first seized Hanyang, threw a pontoon bridge across the river, and attacked Wuchang.

sentences.zh: 提督向榮自湖南來援，距城十餘裡，阻賊不得前。

translations.literal: Provincial Military Commander Xiang Rong came from Hunan to relieve the city but halted more than ten li from the walls, blocked by the rebels and unable to advance.
translations.idiomatic: Military Commander Xiang Rong marched from Hunan to relieve the city but halted more than ten li away, blocked by rebel forces and unable to advance.

sentences.zh: 十二月，賊由江岸穴地轟城，遂陷，大淳死之，妻劉、子集松、子婦馬、孫女淑英並殉。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the rebels tunneled under the riverbank and blasted the walls; the city then fell; Dachun died in the defense; his wife Liu, his son Jisong, his daughter-in-law Ma, and his granddaughter Shuying all perished with him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the rebels dug under the riverbank and blasted the walls; the city fell and Dachun was killed; his wife Liu, his son Jisong, his daughter-in-law Ma, and his granddaughter Shuying all died with him.

sentences.zh: 詔贈總督，諡文節，祀昭忠祠，並於湖北建立專祠。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously granted him the rank of governor-general, gave him the posthumous title Wenjie, enshrined him in the Shrine of Manifest Loyalty, and also established a dedicated shrine for him in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: An edict posthumously promoted him to governor-general, conferred the posthumous title Wenjie, enshrined him in the Shrine of Manifest Loyalty, and ordered a dedicated shrine built for him in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 同城文武被難者，提督雙福，學政、光祿寺卿馮培元，布政使梁星源，按察使瑞元，道員王壽同、王東槐、林恩熙，知府明善、董振鐸，同知周祖銜，知縣繡麟，而總兵王錦繡、常祿皆以援師入城助守，同殉焉。

translations.literal: Among the civil and military officials of the same city who perished in the disaster were Provincial Military Commander Shuang Fu; Educational Commissioner and Court of Imperial Sacrifices Minister Feng Peiyuan; Provincial Treasurer Liang Xingyuan; Provincial Judicial Commissioner Rui Yuan; circuit intendants Wang Shoutong, Wang Donghuai, and Lin Enxi; prefects Ming Shan and Dong Zhenduo; subprefect Zhou Zuyin; and magistrate Xiulin; while regional commanders Wang Jinxiu and Chang Lu had both entered the city with relief forces to help defend and likewise died with the rest.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials who perished in the same city included Military Commander Shuang Fu; Educational Commissioner and Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Feng Peiyuan; Provincial Treasurer Liang Xingyuan; Provincial Judicial Commissioner Rui Yuan; circuit intendants Wang Shoutong, Wang Donghuai, and Lin Enxi; prefects Ming Shan and Dong Zhenduo; subprefect Zhou Zuyin; and magistrate Xiulin; regional commanders Wang Jinxiu and Chang Lu had entered with relief columns to help defend and died there as well.

sentences.zh: 馮培元、王東槐自有傳。

translations.literal: Feng Peiyuan and Wang Donghuai have their own biographies.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Peiyuan and Wang Donghuai have separate biographies.

sentences.zh: 雙福，他塔拉氏，滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: Shuang Fu, of the Tatara clan, was a Bannerman of the Plain White Banner of the Manchus.
translations.idiomatic: Shuang Fu, of the Tatara clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 由護軍從征喀什噶爾，洊升參領，出為湖北副將。

translations.literal: Starting as a guardsman he campaigned in Kashgar, was repeatedly promoted to company commander, and went out to serve as deputy regional commander of Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: Beginning as a guardsman he campaigned in Kashgar, rose through repeated promotions to company commander, and was appointed deputy regional commander of Hubei.

sentences.zh: 剿崇陽匪鍾人傑，功最，賜號烏爾瑪斯巴圖魯，累擢河北、古州兩鎮總兵，江南提督。

translations.literal: In suppressing the Chongyang bandit Zhong Renjie his merit was foremost; he was granted the title Urumqi Baturu and was repeatedly promoted to regional commander of the Hebei and Guzhou garrisons and to provincial military commander of Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the campaign against the Chongyang rebel Zhong Renjie his merit ranked first; he received the title Urumqi Baturu and rose through successive promotions to regional commander of the Hebei and Guzhou garrisons and provincial military commander of Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 大淳疏請留防，改授湖北提督。

translations.literal: Dachun memorialized asking that he be retained for defense, and he was reassigned as provincial military commander of Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: At Dachun's request he was kept for the defense of Hubei and appointed provincial military commander there.

sentences.zh: 城陷，死之。

translations.literal: When the city fell he died in the defense.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell he was killed in its defense.

sentences.zh: 子德齡，同遇害。

translations.literal: His son Deling perished in the same disaster.
translations.idiomatic: His son Deling was killed in the same attack.

sentences.zh: 予騎都尉兼雲騎尉世職，諡武烈。

translations.literal: He was granted the hereditary offices of Commandant of Cavalry and Cloud Cavalry Captain, with the posthumous title Wulie.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted the combined hereditary ranks of Commandant of Cavalry and Cloud Cavalry Captain, with the posthumous title Wulie.

sentences.zh: 王錦繡，廣西馬平人。

translations.literal: Wang Jinxiu was a native of Maping in Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jinxiu was a native of Maping in Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 由行伍累擢雲南曲尋協副將。

translations.literal: From the ranks he was repeatedly promoted to deputy regional commander of the Qujing garrison in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Rising through the ranks he was repeatedly promoted to deputy regional commander of the Qujing garrison in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 率滇兵赴廣西剿匪，擢鄖陽鎮總兵。

translations.literal: He led Yunnan troops to Guangxi to suppress bandits and was promoted to regional commander of the Yunyang garrison.
translations.idiomatic: He led Yunnan troops into Guangxi to suppress bandits and was promoted to regional commander of the Yunyang garrison.

sentences.zh: 常祿，富察氏，滿洲鑲白旗人。

translations.literal: Chang Lu, of the Fuca clan, was a Bannerman of the Bordered White Banner of the Manchus.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Lu, of the Fuca clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 由護軍校洊擢雲南副將。

translations.literal: Starting as a guards officer he was repeatedly promoted to deputy regional commander of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Beginning as a guards officer he rose through repeated promotions to deputy regional commander of Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 剿廣西匪，擢河北鎮總兵，賜號強謙巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In suppressing bandits in Guangxi he was promoted to regional commander of the Hebei garrison and granted the title Qiangqian Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: After suppressing bandits in Guangxi he was promoted to regional commander of the Hebei garrison and granted the title Qiangqian Baturu.

sentences.zh: 錦繡、常祿轉戰廣西、湖南，皆有功績。

translations.literal: Jinxiu and Chang Lu fought through Guangxi and Hunan in turn, both with meritorious records.
translations.idiomatic: Jinxiu and Chang Lu campaigned through Guangxi and Hunan in turn, both with distinguished records of service.

sentences.zh: 及湖北告警，偕同赴援，戰於蒲圻，獲勝，遂入武昌嬰城固守。

translations.literal: When alarm was raised in Hubei they went together to relieve it, fought at Puqi and won, then entered Wuchang, closed the city, and held it fast.
translations.idiomatic: When Hubei was threatened they marched together to its relief, won a battle at Puqi, entered Wuchang, and shut themselves in to hold the city.

sentences.zh: 城陷，巷戰，同死之，並優恤，予騎都尉兼雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: When the city fell they fought in the lanes and died together; both received special compassionate grants and were given the hereditary offices of Commandant of Cavalry and Cloud Cavalry Captain.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell they fought street by street and died together; both received exceptional posthumous honors and the combined hereditary ranks of Commandant of Cavalry and Cloud Cavalry Captain.

sentences.zh: 錦繡諡壯節，常祿諡剛節。

translations.literal: Jinxiu received the posthumous title Zhuangjie; Chang Lu received the posthumous title Gangjie.
translations.idiomatic: Jinxiu was given the posthumous title Zhuangjie; Chang Lu was given the posthumous title Gangjie.

sentences.zh: 王壽同，江蘇高郵人，尚書引之子。

translations.literal: Wang Shoutong was a native of Gaoyou in Jiangsu and the son of Minister Yin.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shoutong, a native of Gaoyou in Jiangsu, was the son of Minister Yin.

sentences.zh: 捐納刑部郎中。

translations.literal: He purchased the office of director in the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He purchased appointment as a director in the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 道光二十四年進士。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in the twenty-fourth year of Daoguang.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the twenty-fourth year of the Daoguang reign (1844).

sentences.zh: 用原官遷御史，出為貴州黎平知府，擢湖北漢黃德道。

translations.literal: Using his original office he was transferred to censor, went out to serve as prefect of Liping in Guizhou, and was promoted to the Hankou-Huangzhou-Dezhou circuit intendant of Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to censor under his purchased rank, appointed prefect of Liping in Guizhou, and promoted to Hankou-Huangzhou-Dezhou circuit intendant in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 在黃州募勇，令子恩晉訓練，得精銳四百人。

translations.literal: At Huangzhou he recruited braves and had his son Enjin train them, obtaining four hundred elite troops.
translations.idiomatic: At Huangzhou he recruited militia and put his son Enjin in charge of training them, raising four hundred crack troops.

sentences.zh: 武昌被圍，壽同率以赴援。

translations.literal: When Wuchang was besieged Shoutong led his force to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: When Wuchang came under siege Shoutong led his troops to its relief.

sentences.zh: 衝賊營縋城入，任戰守，屢擊斬攻城賊。

translations.literal: He charged the rebel camp and was lowered into the city by rope, took charge of fighting and defense, and repeatedly struck down rebels who assaulted the walls.
translations.idiomatic: He broke through the rebel camp and was lowered into the city by rope, took charge of the defense, and repeatedly killed rebels assaulting the walls.

sentences.zh: 以甕德法知賊由江岸穴地道，方鑿穴出擊，地雷發，壽同率恩晉巷戰，同遇害。

translations.literal: Through Weng Defa he learned that the rebels were tunneling under the riverbank; just as he was digging out to counterattack a land mine exploded; Shoutong led Enjin in lane fighting and both were killed.
translations.idiomatic: Weng Defa informed him that the rebels were tunneling under the riverbank; as he was digging out to counterattack a mine detonated; Shoutong led Enjin in street fighting and both were killed.

sentences.zh: 予騎都尉世職，祀京師昭忠祠，與子恩晉同於本籍建忠孝祠，賜兩子恩錫、恩炳並為舉人。

translations.literal: He was granted the hereditary office of Commandant of Cavalry, enshrined in the capital Shrine of Manifest Loyalty, and together with his son Enjin a shrine of loyalty and filial piety was built in their native place; his two sons Enxi and Enbing were both granted the rank of provincial graduate.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted the hereditary rank of Commandant of Cavalry and enshrined in the capital Shrine of Manifest Loyalty; a joint shrine of loyalty and filial piety was built for him and his son Enjin in their home district; his sons Enxi and Enbing were both granted the rank of provincial graduate.

sentences.zh: 後左都御史單​​懋謙疏陳壽同治績，追諡忠介。

translations.literal: Later Left Censor-in-Chief Shan Maoqian memorialized setting forth Shoutong's achievements in office, and he was posthumously given the title Zhongjie.
translations.idiomatic: Later Left Censor-in-Chief Shan Maoqian memorialized detailing Shoutong's record in office, and he was posthumously granted the title Zhongjie.

sentences.zh: =蔣文慶=蔣文慶，字蔚亭，漢軍正白旗人。

translations.literal: Jiang Wenqing: Jiang Wenqing, courtesy name Weiting, was a Bannerman of the Hanjun Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Wenqing, courtesy name Weiting, was a Hanjun Bannerman of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十九年進士，授吏部主事，遷員外郎。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in the nineteenth year of Jiaqing, was appointed a director in the Ministry of Personnel, and was promoted to vice director.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the nineteenth year of the Jiaqing reign (1814), was appointed a director in the Ministry of Personnel, and was promoted to vice director.

sentences.zh: 出為雲南曲靖知府，調雲南府。

translations.literal: He went out to serve as prefect of Qujing in Yunnan and was transferred to the prefecture of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed prefect of Qujing in Yunnan and later transferred to the Yunnan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 道光十二年，擢甘肅寧夏道。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Daoguang he was promoted to the Ningxia circuit intendant of Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of the Daoguang reign (1832) he was promoted to Ningxia circuit intendant in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 在邊十年，濬渠，興水利。

translations.literal: On the frontier for ten years he dredged canals and promoted water conservancy.
translations.idiomatic: During ten years on the frontier he dredged canals and developed irrigation works.

sentences.zh: 遷浙江按察使，護理巡撫，遷安徽布政使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to provincial judicial commissioner of Zhejiang, acted as governor, and was transferred to provincial treasurer of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to provincial judicial commissioner of Zhejiang, served as acting governor, and was then appointed provincial treasurer of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 文宗即位，下詔求賢，巡撫王植薦之，咸豐元年，就擢巡撫。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wenzong ascended the throne he issued an edict seeking worthy men; Governor Wang Zhi recommended him, and in the first year of Xianfeng he was immediately promoted to governor.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wenzong came to the throne he issued an edict calling for worthy men; Governor Wang Zhi recommended Wenqing, and in the first year of Xianfeng (1851) he was promoted directly to governor.

sentences.zh: 奏請鳳、潁所屬宜練團，與保甲並行。

translations.literal: He memorialized asking that the districts subordinate to Fengyang and Yingzhou should train militia companies to operate alongside the baojia system.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that districts under Fengyang and Yingzhou should train militia companies alongside the baojia household-registration system.

sentences.zh: 二年，粵匪犯長沙，命遣安徽兵一千赴援湖北。

translations.literal: In the second year Cantonese rebels attacked Changsha; he was ordered to send a thousand Anhui troops to relieve Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianfeng (1852), when Cantonese rebels threatened Changsha, he was ordered to dispatch a thousand Anhui troops to reinforce Hubei.

sentences.zh: 總督陸建瀛慮賊窺吉安，請所調兵改赴江西。

translations.literal: Governor-General Lu Jianying feared the rebels might spy out Ji'an and requested that the troops called up be redirected to Jiangxi instead.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Lu Jianying feared the rebels might threaten Ji'an and asked that the troops be redirected to Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 文慶疏言：「安慶、潛山等營已起程者，毋庸北還；

translations.literal: Wenqing memorialized: "The battalions of Anqing, Qianshan, and the like that have already set out need not return north;
translations.idiomatic: Wenqing memorialized: "The Anqing, Qianshan, and other battalions already on the march need not be recalled north;

sentences.zh: 其未出境之徽、寧二營改赴江西；

translations.literal: the two battalions of Huizhou and Ningguo that have not yet left the province should be redirected to Jiangxi;
translations.idiomatic: the Huizhou and Ningguo battalions not yet beyond the border should be sent to Jiangxi instead;

sentences.zh: 仍各募足千人，俾資援應。

translations.literal: each should still recruit a full thousand men to provide mutual support.
translations.idiomatic: each should still recruit a full thousand men to provide mutual support.

sentences.zh: 惟安徽兵僅六千，各有分防汛地，省垣單危。

translations.literal: Yet Anhui has only six thousand troops, each with assigned garrison and flood-defense posts, and the provincial capital stands alone and in peril.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Anhui has only six thousand troops, each with assigned garrison and flood-defense duties, leaving the provincial capital dangerously exposed.

sentences.zh: 潁、鳳民團強勁，臣擬增募二千；

translations.literal: the militia of Yingzhou and Fengyang are strong; your servant proposes to recruit two thousand more;
translations.idiomatic: The militia of Yingzhou and Fengyang are formidable; I propose recruiting two thousand more;

sentences.zh: 如賊氛益熾，請調江蘇兵三千。

translations.literal: if the rebel menace grows fiercer, I beg to call up three thousand troops from Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: if rebel activity intensifies, I request three thousand troops from Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 統計庫帑撥解甘肅、河工及本省兵餉銀五十五萬兩，近又以十餘萬解楚，實已無餘。

translations.literal: In all the treasury has disbursed five hundred fifty thousand taels to Gansu, river works, and this province's military pay; recently more than a hundred thousand more were sent to Chu, and in truth nothing remains.
translations.idiomatic: In all the treasury has disbursed five hundred fifty thousand taels to Gansu, river works, and provincial military pay; recently more than a hundred thousand more went to Hubei, leaving nothing in reserve.

sentences.zh: 乞將續收地丁契雜及蕪、鳳兩關稅入截留備用。」

translations.literal: I beg that continuing receipts of land tax, deed tax, miscellaneous levies, and customs revenue from the two passes of Wuhu and Fengyang be retained for local use.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that ongoing receipts of land tax, deed tax, miscellaneous levies, and customs revenue from the Wuhu and Fengyang passes be retained for local use.

sentences.zh: 建瀛以文慶張皇，漸生異議。

translations.literal: Jianying regarded Wenqing as alarmist and gradually came to differ with him.
translations.idiomatic: Jianying regarded Wenqing as alarmist and gradually grew at odds with him.

sentences.zh: 及賊至岳州，復申募勇留餉前議，始奉總理安徽防剿之命，遣按察使張熙宇、游擊賡音布扼小孤山，自與壽春鎮總兵恩長籌守禦。

translations.literal: When the rebels reached Yuezhou he again pressed his earlier proposals to recruit braves and retain funds; only then did he receive the commission to take general charge of Anhui defense and suppression; he sent Provincial Judicial Commissioner Zhang Xiyu and Colonel Gengyinbu to hold Xiaogushan, while he himself joined Regional Commander Enchang of the Shou-chun garrison in planning defense.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels reached Yuezhou he renewed his proposals to recruit militia and retain funds; only then was he appointed to take overall charge of Anhui's defense; he sent Provincial Judicial Commissioner Zhang Xiyu and Colonel Gengyinbu to hold Xiaogushan while he joined Regional Commander Enchang of the Shouchun garrison in planning the defense.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，賊已陷武昌，陸建瀛督師迎剿，令福山鎮總兵王鵬飛以二千人防安慶，而調恩長為行營翼長。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year the rebels had already taken Wuchang; Lu Jianying directed the army to meet and suppress them, ordered Regional Commander Wang Pengfei of the Fushan garrison to defend Anqing with two thousand men, and transferred Enchang to serve as wing commander of the field headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year of Xianfeng (1853), after Wuchang had fallen, Lu Jianying took command to meet the rebels, ordered Regional Commander Wang Pengfei of the Fushan garrison to defend Anqing with two thousand men, and transferred Enchang to wing commander of his field headquarters.

sentences.zh: 鵬飛駐兵北門外，以客將馭新兵，安慶勢益危。

translations.literal: Pengfei stationed his troops outside the north gate; as an outsider commanding raw recruits, Anqing's situation grew ever more perilous.
translations.idiomatic: Pengfei camped outside the north gate; as an outsider commanding raw recruits, Anqing's position grew ever more precarious.

sentences.zh: 文慶母年八十餘，久病，送之登舟。

translations.literal: Wenqing's mother was more than eighty years old and long ill; he sent her aboard a boat.
translations.idiomatic: Wenqing's mother was over eighty and had been ill for years; he put her aboard a boat to leave.

sentences.zh: 建瀛方溯江而上，見之大怒，將具疏劾之，語頗聞。

translations.literal: Jianying was then proceeding upriver and, seeing this, was greatly angered and was about to draw up a memorial to impeach him; word of this spread.
translations.idiomatic: Jianying was proceeding upriver at the time; seeing this he flew into a rage and prepared a memorial of impeachment; word of it spread.

sentences.zh: 及至，文慶稱病不出，曰：「我旦夕且得罪去耳！」

translations.literal: When he arrived Wenqing claimed illness and would not come out, saying: "I shall soon be dismissed in disgrace!"
translations.idiomatic: When Jianying arrived Wenqing pleaded illness and refused to meet him, saying, "I shall soon be dismissed in disgrace!"

sentences.zh: 建瀛至黃州，賊連舟蔽江下，恩長戰歿，兵潰於武穴，建瀛遂返，過安慶，文慶要入城計事，已不及，熙宇、鵬飛皆棄防地走。

translations.literal: Jianying reached Huangzhou; rebel boats linked together covered the river as they swept downstream; Enchang died in battle; the troops collapsed at Wuxue; Jianying then turned back; passing Anqing he wanted Wenqing to enter the city to plan affairs, but it was already too late; Xiyu and Pengfei both abandoned their defenses and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Jianying reached Huangzhou as rebel fleets filled the river downstream; Enchang was killed in battle and the army broke at Wuxue; Jianying turned back and, passing Anqing, wanted Wenqing to enter the city to confer, but it was too late—Xiyu and Pengfei had both abandoned their posts and fled.

sentences.zh: 漕督週天爵奉命助守安慶，方留剿鳳、潁土匪，書抵文慶畫退守廬州之策。

translations.literal: Grain Transport Commissioner Zhou Tianjue had been ordered to help defend Anqing but was still detained suppressing bandits in Fengyang and Yingzhou; he wrote to Wenqing outlining a plan to withdraw and hold Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Grain Transport Commissioner Zhou Tianjue had been ordered to help defend Anqing but was still engaged against bandits in Fengyang and Yingzhou; he wrote to Wenqing proposing a withdrawal to Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 文慶奏上其書，賊遽至，城北兵潰，而城中譁言將退廬州，紛紛縋城下，斬之不可止。

translations.literal: Wenqing memorialized submitting the letter; the rebels suddenly arrived; the troops north of the city collapsed; meanwhile in the city rumor spread that they would withdraw to Luzhou, and men scrambled down the walls by rope in numbers that executions could not stop.
translations.idiomatic: Wenqing forwarded the letter to the throne; the rebels arrived suddenly; the northern garrison broke; rumor spread through the city that they would withdraw to Luzhou, and soldiers scrambled down the walls by rope in numbers that even executions could not halt.

sentences.zh: 文慶吞金不死，飲藥悶絕，家人輿之出，遇賊於門，遂被害。

translations.literal: Wenqing swallowed gold but did not die; he drank poison and fell into a stupor; his family carried him out on a litter; he met the rebels at the gate and was then killed.
translations.idiomatic: Wenqing swallowed gold but failed to die; he took poison and lost consciousness; his family carried him out on a litter and met the rebels at the gate, where he was killed.

sentences.zh: 從僕以席覆屍，赴桐城呈報，漏言自裁事。

translations.literal: A servant covered the corpse with a mat, went to Tongcheng to report, and let slip word of the suicide attempt.
translations.idiomatic: A servant covered the body with a mat, went to Tongcheng to report the death, and let slip that Wenqing had tried to take his own life.

sentences.zh: 賊既去，子長綬集僚屬耆老集視，然後殮。

translations.literal: After the rebels had gone his son Changshou gathered officials and elders to view the body together, and only then was it encoffined.
translations.idiomatic: After the rebels withdrew his son Changshou gathered officials and local elders to view the body, and only then was it encoffined.

sentences.zh: 詔詰遺疏與呈報不符，向榮疏陳本末，乃賜卹如例，予騎都尉世職，入祀昭忠祠，安慶建專祠，諡忠愨。

translations.literal: An edict questioned why his final memorial did not match the report submitted; Xiang Rong memorialized setting forth the whole sequence of events; only then was compassionate grant given according to precedent, the hereditary office of Commandant of Cavalry conferred, he was enshrined in the Shrine of Manifest Loyalty, a dedicated shrine was built at Anqing, and he received the posthumous title Zhongque.
translations.idiomatic: An edict questioned the discrepancy between his final memorial and the official report; Xiang Rong memorialized explaining the full sequence of events; compassionate grants were then awarded as usual, with the hereditary rank of Commandant of Cavalry, enshrinement in the Shrine of Manifest Loyalty, a dedicated shrine at Anqing, and the posthumous title Zhongque.

sentences.zh: =陶恩培=陶恩培，字益之，浙江山陰人。

translations.literal: Tao Enpei: Tao Enpei, courtesy name Yizhi, a native of Shanyin in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Tao Enpei, courtesy name Yizhi, was a native of Shanyin in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 道光十五年進士，選庶吉士，授編修，遷御史。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in the fifteenth year of Daoguang, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, appointed compiler, and promoted to censor.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the fifteenth year of the Daoguang reign (1835), entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, was appointed compiler, and was later promoted to censor.

sentences.zh: 出為湖南衡州知府。

translations.literal: He went out to serve as prefect of Hengzhou in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed prefect of Hengzhou in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，廣西賊起，衡州奸民左家發謀響應，捕誅之，晉秩道員。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng rebels rose in Guangxi; the Hengzhou scoundrel Zuo Jiafa plotted to respond in concert; Enpei captured and executed him and was promoted in rank to circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xianfeng (1851), when rebels rose in Guangxi, the Hengzhou troublemaker Zuo Jiafa plotted to join them; Enpei captured and executed him and was promoted to circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 二年春，粵匪犯衡陽。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year Cantonese rebels attacked Hengyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the second year of Xianfeng (1852), Cantonese rebels threatened Hengyang.

sentences.zh: 總督程矞採方駐郡，聞警，遽欲退保省城。

translations.literal: Governor-General Cheng Yucai was then stationed in the prefecture; hearing the alarm he immediately wished to withdraw and hold only the provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Cheng Yucai was stationed in the prefecture; on hearing the alarm he immediately wanted to withdraw to the provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 恩培曰：「衡州，楚之門戶，棄則全楚震矣！」

translations.literal: Enpei said: "Hengzhou is the gateway of Chu; if we abandon it all Chu will be shaken!"
translations.idiomatic: Enpei said, "Hengzhou is the gateway to Hunan; if we abandon it the whole province will be shaken!"

sentences.zh: 勿聽。

translations.literal: He would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng would not listen.

sentences.zh: 乃與約，毋撤糧台，得便宜行事。

translations.literal: Enpei then made an agreement with him not to withdraw the grain depot and to be allowed to act at discretion.
translations.idiomatic: Enpei then secured an agreement not to withdraw the grain depot and to act at his own discretion.

sentences.zh: 恩培誅鋤內奸，撫循兵士。

translations.literal: Enpei executed and rooted out internal traitors and comforted the troops.
translations.idiomatic: Enpei rooted out collaborators within the city and steadied the troops.

sentences.zh: 賊知有備，由他道竄陷道州，犯長沙，所至皆破，惟衡州獨完。

translations.literal: The rebels, knowing he was prepared, slipped away by another route, burst into Daozhou, attacked Changsha, and everywhere they went was broken—only Hengzhou remained intact.
translations.idiomatic: Finding the city prepared, the rebels slipped away by another route, seized Daozhou, and attacked Changsha, sweeping through every place they reached—only Hengzhou held firm.

sentences.zh: 御史黎吉雲以狀聞，文宗嘉之。

translations.literal: Censor Li Jiyun reported the situation to the throne, and Emperor Wenzong praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Li Jiyun reported these facts to the throne, and Emperor Wenzong commended him.

sentences.zh: 三年，超擢湖南按察使。

translations.literal: In the third year he was promoted out of turn to provincial judicial commissioner of Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xianfeng (1853) he was promoted out of turn to provincial judicial commissioner of Hunan.

sentences.zh: 剿平衡山、安仁、瀏陽、醴陵土匪，遷山西布政使。

translations.literal: He suppressed bandits at Pingshan, Anren, Liuyang, and Liling, and was transferred to provincial treasurer of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: After suppressing bandits at Pingshan, Anren, Liuyang, and Liling he was appointed provincial treasurer of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 巡撫駱秉章以恩培在湖南久，疏留襄辦防務，允之。

translations.literal: Governor Luo Bingzhang, because Enpei had long served in Hunan, memorialized to retain him to assist in defense affairs, and this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Luo Bingzhang, noting Enpei's long service in Hunan, memorialized to keep him to assist in defense work, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 尋調任江蘇。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 四年，擢湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was promoted to governor of Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Xianfeng (1854) he was promoted to governor of Hubei.

sentences.zh: 時武漢再复，城郭殘破，旁近皆賊踪，總督楊霈擁兵廣濟，按察使胡林翼出省防剿。

translations.literal: At that time Wuhan had been recovered a second time; the walls and streets lay in ruins; rebel tracks surrounded it on every side; Governor-General Yang Fu held troops at Guangji; Provincial Judicial Commissioner Hu Linyi had gone out of the province on defensive suppression duty.
translations.idiomatic: Wuhan had been retaken but the city lay in ruins, with rebel activity all around; Governor-General Yang Fu massed troops at Guangji while Provincial Judicial Commissioner Hu Linyi was away campaigning.

sentences.zh: 或說恩培曰：「省城不可守，宜遷治他郡。」

translations.literal: Some advised Enpei: "The provincial capital cannot be held; you should move the seat of government to another prefecture."
translations.idiomatic: Some urged Enpei, "The provincial capital cannot be defended; you should relocate the government elsewhere."

sentences.zh: 恩培斥其非，兼程進，歲將盡蒞任，文武員弁不足三十，兵不盈千，餉不逾萬。

translations.literal: Enpei denounced this as wrong, pressed on by forced marches, and took office as the year was ending; civil and military officers numbered fewer than thirty, troops fewer than a thousand, and funds no more than ten thousand taels.
translations.idiomatic: Enpei rejected the advice and pressed on by forced marches, arriving as the year was ending with fewer than thirty civil and military officers, fewer than a thousand troops, and funds of barely ten thousand taels.

sentences.zh: 恩培馳書曾國籓乞援，檄胡林翼回保省城。

translations.literal: Enpei sent urgent letters to Zeng Guofan begging relief and ordered Hu Linyi by dispatch to return and defend the provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: Enpei wrote urgently to Zeng Guofan begging for reinforcements and ordered Hu Linyi by dispatch to return and defend the provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 會楊霈敗走蘄州，次於德安。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Yang Fu was defeated and fled to Qizhou, halting at De'an.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Yang Fu was defeated and retreated to Qizhou, halting at De'an.

sentences.zh: 五月正月，漢陽、漢口並為賊踞，興國、通山、嘉魚土匪應之，武昌益孤。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year Hanyang and Hankou were both occupied by rebels; bandits in Xingguo, Tongshan, and Jiayu responded in concert, and Wuchang grew ever more isolated.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year of Xianfeng (1855), Hanyang and Hankou both fell to the rebels; local bandits in Xingguo, Tongshan, and Jiayu rose in support, leaving Wuchang increasingly isolated.

sentences.zh: 恩培盡焚沿江木植，盡驅諸船，故賊未得渡，而道員李孟群、知府彭玉麟以水師至，胡林翼以陸師至，聲勢稍壯。

translations.literal: Enpei burned all trees along the river and drove away all boats, so the rebels could not cross; then Circuit Intendant Li Mengqun and Prefect Peng Yulin arrived with the naval force and Hu Linyi with the land force, and their strength grew somewhat.
translations.idiomatic: Enpei burned riverside timber and cleared away all boats so the rebels could not cross; when Circuit Intendant Li Mengqun and Prefect Peng Yulin arrived with the fleet and Hu Linyi with the army, government strength improved somewhat.

sentences.zh: 賊城沙坡堆，恩培欲先發製之，令林翼統諸軍冒雪出不意，三路攻賊。

translations.literal: The rebels fortified Shapodui; Enpei wished to strike first and control them, and ordered Linyi to command the armies, march out in the snow by surprise, and attack the rebels on three routes.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fortified Shapodui; Enpei wanted to strike first and ordered Linyi to lead the armies out through the snow in a surprise attack on three routes.

sentences.zh: 士卒畏寒不欲戰，渡江營沌口，師期頗洩，賊得為備。

translations.literal: The troops feared the cold and did not wish to fight; they crossed the river and encamped at Zhunkou; the timing of the campaign was largely leaked, and the rebels were able to prepare.
translations.idiomatic: The troops shrank from the cold and refused to fight; they crossed the river and camped at Zhunkou; battle plans leaked, and the rebels were ready.

sentences.zh: 林翼慮兵力分，並為一路。

translations.literal: Linyi feared the forces were divided and combined them into a single route.
translations.idiomatic: Linyi, fearing his forces were too divided, combined them into a single column.

sentences.zh: 舟師先薄小龜山，陸師繼進。

translations.literal: The fleet first pressed Little Tortoise Hill and the land force followed.
translations.idiomatic: The fleet advanced first against Little Tortoise Hill, with the army following.

sentences.zh: 賊出馬步數千，從漢口鈔我軍，复敗退大軍山。

translations.literal: The rebels sent out several thousand cavalry and infantry, outflanked our army from Hankou, and were again defeated and driven back to Dajunshan.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels sent out several thousand horse and foot, outflanked the government forces from Hankou, and were driven back again to Dajunshan.

sentences.zh: 賊舟大集，晝夜攻城。

translations.literal: Rebel boats gathered in great numbers and assaulted the city day and night.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel fleets massed and assaulted the city day and night.

sentences.zh: 楊霈約三路來援，以火為號。

translations.literal: Yang Fu agreed to come to the relief on three routes, using fire as the signal.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Fu promised relief on three routes, with fire as the signal.

sentences.zh: 林翼、孟群整軍以待，屢見火起，為所紿，而霈軍不至。

translations.literal: Linyi and Mengqun arrayed their troops and waited; fires rose again and again, but they were deceived, and Yang Fu's army never came.
translations.idiomatic: Linyi and Mengqun arrayed their troops and waited; fires rose repeatedly, but they were deceived, and Yang Fu's army never arrived.

sentences.zh: 二月，賊由興國、通山來助攻。

translations.literal: In the second month rebels came from Xingguo and Tongshan to join the assault.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month rebels from Xingguo and Tongshan joined the assault.

sentences.zh: 林翼兵隔江為賊所綴，不能渡。

translations.literal: Linyi's troops were separated from the city by the river and pinned by the rebels, unable to cross.
translations.idiomatic: Linyi's troops were cut off across the river by rebel forces and could not cross.

sentences.zh: 城中出兵連戰於青山、望江樓，皆挫。

translations.literal: Troops sent out from the city fought repeatedly at Qingshan and Wangjiang Tower, and were defeated each time.
translations.idiomatic: Forces sent from the city fought repeatedly at Qingshan and Wangjiang Tower and were beaten back each time.

sentences.zh: 直逼大小東門，恩培自當之，令武昌知府多山守西北城。

translations.literal: They pressed straight to the Great and Small East Gates; Enpei took them on himself and ordered Wuchang Prefect Duoshan to hold the northwest wall.
translations.idiomatic: They pressed straight toward the Great and Small East Gates; Enpei took charge himself and ordered Wuchang Prefect Duoshan to defend the northwest wall.

sentences.zh: 方戰，忽報漢陽門破，多山戰死。

translations.literal: While the battle was under way word suddenly came that the Hanyang Gate had been breached and Duoshan had died fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Mid-battle came word that the Hanyang Gate had fallen and Duoshan had been killed in action.

sentences.zh: 至暮賊麕集，士卒死傷略盡，恩培投蛇山紫陽塘殉焉。

translations.literal: By evening the rebels had massed; the troops were nearly all killed or wounded; Enpei threw himself into Ziyang Pond on Snake Hill and perished with the city.
translations.idiomatic: By evening the rebels had massed; the garrison was nearly annihilated; Enpei drowned himself in Ziyang Pond on Snake Hill and died with the city.

sentences.zh: 詔優恤，予騎都尉兼雲騎尉世職，諡文節，祀昭忠祠。

translations.literal: An edict granted special compassionate relief, conferred the hereditary offices of Commandant of Cavalry and Cloud Cavalry Captain, gave the posthumous title Wenjie, and enshrined him in the Shrine of Manifest Loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted exceptional posthumous honors, the combined hereditary ranks of Commandant of Cavalry and Cloud Cavalry Captain, the posthumous title Wenjie, and enshrinement in the Shrine of Manifest Loyalty.

sentences.zh: 後在湖北與吳文鎔合建一祠。

translations.literal: Later a joint shrine was built for him in Hubei together with Wu Wenrong.
translations.idiomatic: Later a joint memorial shrine was built for him in Hubei together with Wu Wenrong.

sentences.zh: 多山，赫舍里氏，滿洲鑲藍旗人。

translations.literal: Duoshan, of the Heseri clan, was a Bannerman of the Bordered Blue Banner of the Manchus.
translations.idiomatic: Duoshan, of the Heseri clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 道光十四年舉人，刑部郎中。

translations.literal: He passed the provincial examination in the fourteenth year of Daoguang and served as a director in the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the provincial examination in the fourteenth year of the Daoguang reign (1834) and served as a director in the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 出為襄陽知府，舉行團練，勦賊有功，晉秩道員。

translations.literal: He went out to serve as prefect of Xiangyang, organized militia training, suppressed bandits with merit, and was promoted in rank to circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: As prefect of Xiangyang he organized militia training, suppressed bandits with distinction, and was promoted to circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 調武昌府，署按察使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Wuchang prefecture and acted as provincial judicial commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Wuchang prefecture and served as acting provincial judicial commissioner.

sentences.zh: 時司道多駐城外督戰，惟多山助城守，城陷，力戰死之，予騎都尉世職，諡忠節。

translations.literal: At that time most commissioners and intendants were stationed outside the city directing campaigns; only Duoshan assisted in defending the walls; when the city fell he fought to the death, was granted the hereditary office of Commandant of Cavalry, and received the posthumous title Zhongjie.
translations.idiomatic: Most senior officials were stationed outside the city directing campaigns; only Duoshan remained to help defend the walls; when the city fell he fought to the death, was granted the hereditary rank of Commandant of Cavalry, and received the posthumous title Zhongjie.

sentences.zh: =吉爾杭阿=吉爾杭阿，字雨山，奇特拉氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Ji Erhang'a: Ji Erhang'a, courtesy name Yushan, of the Qitela clan, was a Bannerman of the Bordered Yellow Banner of the Manchus.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Erhang'a, courtesy name Yushan, of the Qitela clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 由工部筆帖式洊遷郎中，充坐糧廳監督。

translations.literal: Starting as a clerk in the Ministry of Works he was repeatedly promoted to director and served as supervisor of the Grain Transport Office.
translations.idiomatic: Beginning as a clerk in the Ministry of Works he rose through repeated promotions to director and served as supervisor of the Grain Transport Office.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年，以孝和睿皇后奉安山陵，晉秩道員。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianfeng, for attending the burial of Empress Xiaohui Rui at the imperial mausoleum, he was promoted in rank to circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xianfeng (1853), for attending the burial of Empress Xiaohui Rui at the imperial mausoleum, he was promoted to circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 揀發江蘇，補常鎮道，署按察使。

translations.literal: Selected for service in Jiangsu, he was appointed to the Chang-Zhen circuit and acted as provincial judicial commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Assigned to Jiangsu, he was appointed to the Chang-Zhen circuit and served as acting provincial judicial commissioner.

sentences.zh: 粵匪已踞江寧、鎮江，會匪劉麗川陷上海。

translations.literal: Cantonese rebels already held Jiangning and Zhenjiang; the secret-society rebel Liu Lichuan took Shanghai.
translations.idiomatic: Cantonese rebels already held Nanjing and Zhenjiang; secret-society rebel Liu Lichuan seized Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 巡撫許乃釗檄吉爾杭阿偕總兵虎嵩林、參將秦如虎合師進剿。

translations.literal: Governor Xu Naigang ordered Ji Erhang'a, together with Regional Commander Hu Songlin and Colonel Qin Ruhu, to combine forces and advance in suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Xu Naigang ordered Ji Erhang'a, Regional Commander Hu Songlin, and Colonel Qin Ruhu to combine forces and advance against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 劉麗川者，廣東香山人。

translations.literal: Liu Lichuan was a native of Xiangshan in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Lichuan was a native of Xiangshan in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 貿易上海，習於洋商，與蘇松太道吳健彰有舊。

translations.literal: He traded in Shanghai, was familiar with foreign merchants, and had old ties with Suzhou-Songjiang-Taicang Circuit Intendant Wu Jianzhang.
translations.idiomatic: He traded in Shanghai, was familiar with foreign merchants, and had long-standing ties with Suzhou-Songjiang-Taicang Circuit Intendant Wu Jianzhang.

sentences.zh: 素行不法，見粵匪勢盛，遂倡亂，糾客籍粵、閩、江右會黨二千人，於三年秋襲上海城，戕知縣袁祖德，劫道庫，吳健彰遁入領事署。

translations.literal: His conduct had long been lawless; seeing the Cantonese rebels grow powerful he then raised rebellion, gathered two thousand fellow-provincials from Guangdong, Fujian, and Jiangxi in secret societies, and in the autumn of the third year assaulted Shanghai city, killed Magistrate Yuan Zude, looted the circuit treasury, and Wu Jianzhang fled into the consulate.
translations.idiomatic: Long known for lawless conduct, he saw Cantonese rebel strength rising and raised a revolt, rallying two thousand migrants from Guangdong, Fujian, and Jiangxi secret societies; in the autumn of the third year of Xianfeng (1853) they stormed Shanghai, killed Magistrate Yuan Zude, looted the circuit treasury, and Wu Jianzhang fled into the foreign consulate.

sentences.zh: 鄰境亂民紛起應之，寶山、嘉定、青浦、南匯、川沙五城連陷。

translations.literal: Troublemakers in neighboring districts rose in response one after another; the five cities of Baoshan, Jiading, Qingpu, Nanhui, and Chuansha fell in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Neighboring districts rose in support; the cities of Baoshan, Jiading, Qingpu, Nanhui, and Chuansha fell one after another.

sentences.zh: 蘇紳捐募川勇千人，刑部主事劉存厚領之，隸於吉爾杭阿為軍鋒，連克青浦、嘉​​定。

translations.literal: Jiangsu gentry donated funds to recruit a thousand Sichuan braves led by Ministry of Justice Director Liu Cunhou; they were placed under Ji Erhang'a as the army's vanguard and in succession took Qingpu and Jiading.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu gentry funded a thousand Sichuan militia led by Ministry of Justice Director Liu Cunhou; placed under Ji Erhang'a as the vanguard, they captured Qingpu and Jiading in succession.

sentences.zh: 諸軍至，五城以次復。

translations.literal: When the armies arrived the five cities were recovered in turn.
translations.idiomatic: When government forces arrived the five cities were recovered one by one.

sentences.zh: 合圍上海，分南北兩營。

translations.literal: They combined to besiege Shanghai, dividing into northern and southern camps.
translations.idiomatic: They combined to besiege Shanghai, establishing northern and southern camps.

sentences.zh: 四年春，存厚穴地轟城，以援兵不繼退。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year Cunhou tunneled under the walls and blasted them, but withdrew because relief troops did not follow up.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year of Xianfeng (1854), Cunhou tunneled under the walls and detonated mines, but withdrew when reinforcements failed to arrive.

sentences.zh: 賊由北門出犯，吉爾杭阿親燃砲擊卻之。

translations.literal: The rebels sallied from the north gate; Ji Erhang'a personally fired the cannon and drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels sallied from the north gate; Ji Erhang'a personally fired the guns and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 賊又劫北營，虎嵩林兵挫。

translations.literal: The rebels again raided the northern camp and Hu Songlin's troops were beaten.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels raided the northern camp again and Hu Songlin's force was defeated.

sentences.zh: 吉爾杭阿固守，得不潰，复擊退西門撲營之賊，超擢布政使，賜花翎，尋擢巡撫。

translations.literal: Ji Erhang'a held firm and kept the line from collapsing, again beat back rebels who rushed the camp at the west gate, was promoted out of turn to provincial treasurer, was granted the peacock feather, and soon after was promoted to governor.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Erhang'a held firm and prevented a rout, then repelled rebels who stormed the western camp; he was promoted out of turn to provincial treasurer, granted the peacock feather, and soon after appointed governor.

sentences.zh: 复於南門掘地道，火發，副將清長先登，沒於陣，兵又退。

translations.literal: Again they dug a tunnel at the south gate; when the blast went off Deputy Regional Commander Qingchang was first to scale the wall and died in battle, and the troops withdrew once more.
translations.idiomatic: They dug another tunnel at the south gate; when the mine exploded Deputy Regional Commander Qingchang was first over the wall and was killed; the troops withdrew again.

sentences.zh: 地鄰租界，匪人暗濟餉械，久不下，乃於洋涇浜築牆塞濠，斷其糧道，賊始困。

translations.literal: The ground adjoined the foreign settlement; rebels were secretly supplied with funds and arms; the city could not be taken for a long time; then at Yangjingbang they built a wall and blocked the moat, cutting off grain routes, and only then did the rebels begin to suffer distress.
translations.idiomatic: Adjacent to the foreign settlement, rebels received secret supplies of funds and arms; the city held out for months until walls were built at Yangjingbang to block the moat and cut supply lines, and only then did the rebels begin to suffer.

sentences.zh: 負嵎已經年，洋商貿易不便，吉爾杭阿開誠曉以利害，於是法國兵官請助剿，英、美領事允讓地設防。

translations.literal: They had held out stubbornly for more than a year; foreign merchants' trade was inconvenienced; Ji Erhang'a spoke frankly and explained the advantages and disadvantages; thereupon the French military officer asked to assist in suppression, and the British and American consuls agreed to yield land for defense posts.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels had held out for more than a year, disrupting foreign trade; Ji Erhang'a spoke frankly about the stakes; the French military officer offered to assist in suppression, and the British and American consuls agreed to cede land for defensive positions.

sentences.zh: 築土牆於陳家木橋，移營進逼，下令投誠免死，縋城出者日以千計。

translations.literal: They built an earthen wall at Chenjiamuqiao, shifted camps forward to press the attack, ordered that those who surrendered would be spared death, and each day a thousand or more were lowered from the walls by rope to come out.
translations.idiomatic: They built an earthen wall at Chenjiamuqiao, advanced the camps, promised amnesty to defectors, and each day a thousand or more rebels lowered themselves from the walls to surrender.

sentences.zh: 賊襲陳家木橋，擊敗之，擒斬悍黨偽將軍林阿朋。

translations.literal: The rebels attacked Chenjiamuqiao and were defeated; the fierce partisan and false general Lin Apeng was captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels attacked Chenjiamuqiao and were defeated; the fierce partisan and self-styled general Lin Apeng was captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 除夕，乘賊不備，地雷發，督兵躍城入，麗川縱火逸，追擒伏誅，餘賊盡殲。

translations.literal: On New Year's Eve, taking advantage of the rebels' unreadiness, a land mine was set off; he directed the troops to leap over the wall into the city; Lichuan set fires and fled; pursued, captured, and executed by ambush; the remaining rebels were wholly exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: On New Year's Eve, catching the rebels unprepared, a mine was detonated and troops scaled the walls; Lichuan set fires and fled but was pursued, captured, and executed; the remaining rebels were annihilated.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，文宗嘉其功，加頭品頂戴，賜號法施善巴圖魯。

translations.literal: When victory was reported Emperor Wenzong praised his merit, added the first-rank official's hat ornament, and granted the title Fashishan Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: When victory was reported Emperor Wenzong commended his achievement, granted the first-rank official's hat ornament, and bestowed the title Fashishan Baturu.

sentences.zh: 五年，命率得勝之兵馳往向榮大營，幫辦軍務，專任鎮江一路。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was ordered to lead his victorious troops swiftly to Xiang Rong's grand camp to assist in military affairs and take sole charge of the Zhenjiang route.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Xianfeng (1855) he was ordered to lead his victorious troops to Xiang Rong's grand camp to assist in military affairs and take sole charge of the Zhenjiang front.

sentences.zh: 鎮江賊酋吳汝孝最桀黠，恃金山為犄角，銀山、寶蓋山並有伏賊。

translations.literal: The Zhenjiang rebel chieftain Wu Ruxiao was the most fierce and cunning; he relied on Jinshan as a flank position, and both Yinshan and Baogai Hill had concealed rebel forces.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhenjiang rebel leader Wu Ruxiao was the fiercest and most cunning; he used Jinshan as a flank position, with hidden rebel forces on Yinshan and Baogai Hill.

sentences.zh: 是年秋，迭攻鎮江西門、南門，堵截金山、瓜洲沿江援賊，累戰皆捷。

translations.literal: That autumn he repeatedly attacked the west and south gates of Zhenjiang, blocked rebel relief along the river from Jinshan and Guazhou, and won victory in battle after battle.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he repeatedly assaulted Zhenjiang's west and south gates, blocked rebel relief along the river from Jinshan and Guazhou, and won battle after battle.

sentences.zh: 虎嵩林克寶蓋山，吉爾杭阿駐營其上，乘黃山發巨砲轟城，賊卡盡毀。

translations.literal: Hu Songlin took Baogai Hill; Ji Erhang'a encamped on it; from Huangshan he fired great cannon to bombard the city, and all the rebel stockades were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Songlin captured Baogai Hill; Ji Erhang'a camped there and, from Huangshan, fired heavy cannon at the city until every rebel stockade was destroyed.

sentences.zh: 江寧賊集大股由北岸渡江來援，吉爾杭阿策高資鎮為賊糧道，遣兵截擊，賊退棲霞石埠橋。

translations.literal: Jiangning rebels gathered a large force that crossed the river from the north bank to relieve the city; Ji Erhang'a judged that Gaozi Town was the rebels' grain route, sent troops to intercept them, and the rebels retreated to Qixia Shibuqiao.
translations.idiomatic: A large Jiangning relief force crossed from the north bank; Ji Erhang'a identified Gaozi as the rebels' supply route, sent troops to intercept them, and drove them back to Qixia Shibuqiao.

sentences.zh: 偕總兵德安扼剿，留劉存厚率三營守高資煙墩山。

translations.literal: Together with Regional Commander De'an he held them in check and pursued suppression, leaving Liu Cunhou with three battalions to guard Yandun Hill at Gaozi.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Regional Commander De'an he pressed the pursuit, leaving Liu Cunhou with three battalions to hold Yandun Hill at Gaozi.

sentences.zh: 六年春，賊糾悍黨陳玉成、李秀成等來援，提督張國樑御之於倉頭鎮。

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixth year the rebels gathered fierce partisans such as Chen Yucheng and Li Xiucheng to come to the relief; Provincial Military Commander Zhang Guoliang met them at Cangtou Town.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the sixth year of Xianfeng (1856), rebels rallied fierce leaders Chen Yucheng and Li Xiucheng to relieve the city; Military Commander Zhang Guoliang met them at Cangtou Town.

sentences.zh: 賊潛由小港出江順流下，城賊突出應，官軍為所乘，賊遂長驅進金雞嶺，逼寶蓋山大營。

translations.literal: The rebels secretly left the river through Little Harbor and swept downstream; rebels in the city sallied out in response; the government army was caught at a disadvantage; the rebels then drove straight to Jinjiling and pressed the great camp on Baogai Hill.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels slipped out through Little Harbor and swept downstream while city garrison forces sallied to meet them; government troops were caught off guard; the rebels drove straight to Jinjiling and threatened the great camp on Baogai Hill.

sentences.zh: 吉爾杭阿拒，賊未得逞，乃渡江犯儀徵、揚州。

translations.literal: Ji Erhang'a resisted them; the rebels did not succeed, then crossed the river and attacked Yizheng and Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Erhang'a held them off and the rebels failed to break through; they then crossed the river and attacked Yizheng and Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月，賊數万复犯高資，存厚告急。

translations.literal: In the fifth month tens of thousands of rebels again attacked Gaozi and Cunhou sent urgent word.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month tens of thousands of rebels again attacked Gaozi, and Cunhou sent urgent appeals for help.

sentences.zh: 大營兵僅八千，或謂：「賊眾且銳，不可當，姑舍高資，徐圖大舉為便。」

translations.literal: The grand camp had only eight thousand troops; some said: "The rebels are numerous and sharp; they cannot be faced; for the moment abandon Gaozi and plan a larger campaign later—that would be best."
translations.idiomatic: The grand camp had only eight thousand men; some urged, "The rebels are numerous and fierce; we cannot face them; abandon Gaozi for now and plan a larger campaign later."

sentences.zh: 吉爾杭阿奮然曰：「一戰絕賊糧道，鎮江旦夕且下。

translations.literal: Ji Erhang'a said with spirit: "One battle will cut off the rebels' grain route, and Zhenjiang will fall within days.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Erhang'a declared spiritedly, "One battle will cut the rebels' supply line, and Zhenjiang will fall within days.

sentences.zh: 吾寧以死報國耳！」

translations.literal: I would rather die repaying the state!"
translations.idiomatic: I would rather die serving the dynasty!"

sentences.zh: 遂馳抵煙墩，被圍，鏖戰五晝夜，親執旗指麾，猝中砲，殞。

translations.literal: He then galloped to Yandun, was surrounded, fought fiercely for five days and nights, personally held the banner to direct operations, was suddenly struck by cannon fire, and perished.
translations.idiomatic: He galloped to Yandun, was surrounded, and fought fiercely for five days and nights, personally directing operations with the banner in hand, until he was struck by cannon fire and killed.

sentences.zh: 存厚護屍突圍出，為賊所要截，歿於陣，並遺骸失之。

translations.literal: Cunhou protected the corpse and broke out of the encirclement, but was intercepted by the rebels, died in battle, and even the remains were lost.
translations.idiomatic: Cunhou tried to protect the body and break out, but was intercepted by rebels, killed in battle, and even the remains were lost.

sentences.zh: 副都統繃闊投江死。

translations.literal: Vice Commander-in-Chief Beng Kuo threw himself into the river and died.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Commander-in-Chief Beng Kuo threw himself into the river and drowned.

sentences.zh: 鎮江軍亦潰，副將周兆熊死之。

translations.literal: The Zhenjiang army also collapsed, and Deputy Regional Commander Zhou Zhaoxiong died.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhenjiang army also collapsed, and Deputy Regional Commander Zhou Zhaoxiong was killed.

sentences.zh: 事聞，文宗震悼，追贈吉爾杭阿總督，予一等輕車都尉世職，諡勇烈。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported Emperor Wenzong was deeply shaken with grief; Ji Erhang'a was posthumously granted the rank of governor-general, given the first-class hereditary office of Commandant of Light Chariots, and received the posthumous title Yonglie.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the throne Emperor Wenzong was deeply grieved; Ji Erhang'a was posthumously promoted to governor-general, granted the first-class hereditary rank of Commandant of Light Chariots, and given the posthumous title Yonglie.

sentences.zh: 於殉難地方建專祠，上海亦建專祠。

translations.literal: A dedicated shrine was built at the place where he died in martyrdom, and another dedicated shrine was built in Shanghai.
translations.idiomatic: A dedicated shrine was built at the site of his death, and another in Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 子文鈺襲世職，賜員外郎。

translations.literal: His son Wenyü inherited the hereditary office and was granted the rank of vice director.
translations.idiomatic: His son Wenyü inherited the hereditary rank and was granted the office of vice director.

sentences.zh: 存厚，字仲山，四川榮縣人。

translations.literal: Cunhou, courtesy name Zhongshan, was a native of Rongxian in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Cunhou, courtesy name Zhongshan, was a native of Rongxian in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 捐納刑部主事。

translations.literal: He purchased the office of director in the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He purchased appointment as a director in the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 好談兵，侍郎王茂廕疏薦，命赴江南大營，向榮命率勇擊賊，輒勝。

translations.literal: He loved to discuss military affairs; Vice Minister Wang Maoyin memorialized recommending him; he was ordered to proceed to the Jiangnan grand camp; Xiang Rong ordered him to lead braves against the rebels, and he always won.
translations.idiomatic: He was fond of military discussion; Vice Minister Wang Maoyin recommended him by memorial; he was ordered to the Jiangnan grand camp, where Xiang Rong put him in charge of militia against the rebels, and he won repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 上海之役，始自領一軍，吉爾杭阿甚倚之。

translations.literal: In the Shanghai campaign he first commanded an army of his own, and Ji Erhang'a relied on him greatly.
translations.idiomatic: In the Shanghai campaign he first commanded his own force, and Ji Erhang'a relied on him heavily.

sentences.zh: 克青浦，冒矢石先登，洊保知府。

translations.literal: In taking Qingpu he braved arrows and stones to be first up the wall and was repeatedly recommended for promotion to prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In capturing Qingpu he braved arrows and stones to be first over the wall and was repeatedly recommended for promotion to prefect.

sentences.zh: 及攻上海，誤殺洋婦，洋人憤，將發兵相攻。

translations.literal: When attacking Shanghai he mistakenly killed a foreign woman; foreigners were enraged and were about to send troops to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: During the assault on Shanghai his troops mistakenly killed a foreign woman; foreigners were enraged and prepared to send troops against him.

sentences.zh: 存厚單騎往曰：「此不足啟邊釁，請以一身償。

translations.literal: Cunhou went alone on horseback and said: "This is not enough to provoke a frontier quarrel; I ask to repay it with my own person.
translations.idiomatic: Cunhou rode alone to them and said, "This is not grounds for a frontier incident; let me answer for it with my own life.

sentences.zh: 若欲戰，雖死不相下也！」

translations.literal: If you wish to fight, even in death I shall not yield!"
translations.idiomatic: If you want a fight, I will not yield even in death!"

sentences.zh: 卒議償卹而定。

translations.literal: In the end compensation was agreed upon and the matter was settled.
translations.idiomatic: In the end compensation was agreed and the matter was settled.

sentences.zh: 圍攻凡數月，方略多出存厚。

translations.literal: The siege lasted several months, and most of the strategy came from Cunhou.
translations.idiomatic: The siege lasted several months, and most of the strategy came from Cunhou.

sentences.zh: 既克，以首功頒賞荷囊，授江寧知府，記名道員。

translations.literal: After the capture he was rewarded for foremost merit with the presentation pouch, appointed prefect of Jiangning, and registered as a circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: After the victory he received the presentation pouch for foremost merit, was appointed prefect of Jiangning, and registered as a circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 從攻鎮江，奪銀山，破瓜洲援賊，爭金雞嶺，皆功最。

translations.literal: In the attack on Zhenjiang he took Yinshan, broke the rebel relief force at Guazhou, and contested Jinjiling—his merit ranked foremost in each.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhenjiang campaign he captured Yinshan, broke rebel relief at Guazhou, and fought for Jinjiling—his merit ranked first in each action.

sentences.zh: 吉爾杭阿以存厚有謀略，故令守高資，及赴援戰歿，存厚大慟，力戰突圍，欲返其屍，中道遇伏，殺賊數百人，馬陷淖，被戕。

translations.literal: Because Ji Erhang'a regarded Cunhou as resourceful in strategy he therefore ordered him to hold Gaozi; when he went to the relief and died in battle Cunhou grieved greatly, fought fiercely to break out, wished to recover the corpse, met an ambush midway, killed several hundred rebels, his horse sank in the mire, and he was slain.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Erhang'a valued Cunhou's strategic talent and left him to hold Gaozi; when Ji Erhang'a died in battle Cunhou grieved deeply, fought to break out and recover the body, was ambushed en route, killed several hundred rebels, but his horse sank in the mire and he was slain.

sentences.zh: 予騎都尉世職，諡剛愍。

translations.literal: He was granted the hereditary office of Commandant of Cavalry and received the posthumous title Gangmin.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted the hereditary rank of Commandant of Cavalry and the posthumous title Gangmin.

sentences.zh: 繃闊，戴佳氏，滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: Beng Kuo, of the Daijia clan, was a Bannerman of the Plain White Banner of the Manchus.
translations.idiomatic: Beng Kuo, of the Daijia clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 官頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: He held the office of first-class imperial bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He served as a first-class imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 從僧格林沁剿林鳳祥，戰連鎮、高唐、馮官屯，積功授正紅旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: He followed Senggelinqin in suppressing Lin Fengxiang, fought at Lianzhen, Gaotang, and Fengguantun, and through accumulated merit was appointed vice commander-in-chief of the Mongol Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Senggelinqin against Lin Fengxiang, fought at Lianzhen, Gaotang, and Fengguantun, and through accumulated merit was appointed vice commander-in-chief of the Mongol Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 調京口，偕吉爾杭阿援高資，軍潰，墮水中，從人拯之，曰：「吾與吉公偕！

translations.literal: Transferred to Jingkou, he joined Ji Erhang'a in relieving Gaozi; the army collapsed; he fell into the water; his attendants rescued him; he said: "I go together with Lord Ji!
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Jingkou, he joined Ji Erhang'a to relieve Gaozi; when the army collapsed he fell into the water; his attendants pulled him out, but he said, "I go with Lord Ji!

sentences.zh: 吉公死，吾不獨生。」

translations.literal: Lord Ji is dead; I will not live alone."
translations.idiomatic: Lord Ji is dead; I will not live on alone."

sentences.zh: 复投江死，諡勇節。

translations.literal: He again threw himself into the river and died, and received the posthumous title Yongjie.
translations.idiomatic: He threw himself into the river again and drowned, receiving the posthumous title Yongjie.

sentences.zh: 兆熊，四川成都人。

translations.literal: Zhaoxiong was a native of Chengdu in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Zhaoxiong was a native of Chengdu in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 官副將。

translations.literal: He held the office of deputy regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: He held the rank of deputy regional commander.

sentences.zh: 從攻鎮江，駐軍城南破子岡，當賊衝。

translations.literal: In the attack on Zhenjiang he stationed troops at Pozigang south of the city, directly in the rebels' path of assault.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhenjiang campaign he stationed troops at Pozigang south of the city, directly in the rebels' line of attack.

sentences.zh: 吉爾杭阿既歿，破子岡為賊困，汲道斷，兆熊固守，時以計誘擊賊，殺傷甚多。

translations.literal: After Ji Erhang'a had perished Pozigang was besieged by rebels; the water route was cut off; Zhaoxiong held firm; from time to time he used stratagems to lure and strike the rebels, killing and wounding many.
translations.idiomatic: After Ji Erhang'a's death Pozigang was besieged; the water supply was cut off; Zhaoxiong held firm and repeatedly lured rebels into ambushes, killing and wounding many.

sentences.zh: 乞援於張國樑，未至，圍益逼，素得士心，無一逃者。

translations.literal: He begged Zhang Guoliang for relief, but help did not arrive; the siege drew tighter; he had long won the hearts of his men, and not one fled.
translations.idiomatic: He begged Zhang Guoliang for relief, but help never came; the siege tightened; he had long won his men's loyalty, and not one deserted.

sentences.zh: 營破，燃火藥自焚，一軍同死，諡果愍。

translations.literal: When the camp was broken he ignited gunpowder and burned himself; the whole army died together, and he received the posthumous title Guomin.
translations.idiomatic: When the camp fell he ignited gunpowder and burned himself to death; the entire force perished with him, and he received the posthumous title Guomin.

sentences.zh: =羅遵殿=羅遵殿，字澹村，安徽宿松人。

translations.literal: Luo Zundian: Luo Zundian, courtesy name Dancun, a native of Susong in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Zundian, courtesy name Dancun, was a native of Susong in Anhui.

sentences.zh: 道光十五年進士，直隸即用知縣，歷南樂、唐山、清苑諸縣，冀州直隸州，皆有聲績。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Daoguang he passed the jinshi examination, was appointed an expectant magistrate of Zhili, and served successively in the counties of Nanle, Tangshan, and Qingyuan and in Jizhou Zhili Prefecture, everywhere winning a distinguished reputation.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the fifteenth year of the Daoguang reign (1835), was appointed an expectant magistrate of Zhili, and served successively in Nanle, Tangshan, Qingyuan, and Jizhou in Zhili, earning a distinguished reputation at each post.

sentences.zh: 擢浙江湖州知府，調杭州，擢湖北安襄鄖荊道。

translations.literal: He was promoted to prefect of Huzhou in Zhejiang, transferred to Hangzhou, and promoted to the Anxiang-Yun-Jing circuit intendant of Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to prefect of Huzhou in Zhejiang, transferred to Hangzhou, and then promoted to intendant of the Anxiang-Yun-Jing circuit in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 遵殿在浙，以捕盜名。

translations.literal: Zundian in Zhejiang was famed for capturing bandits.
translations.idiomatic: While serving in Zhejiang, Zundian won renown for suppressing banditry.

sentences.zh: 至湖北，檄所屬治團練，楚北民團自此始。

translations.literal: Upon reaching Hubei he issued orders to his subordinates to organize militia training, and civilian corps in northern Chu began from this.
translations.idiomatic: On reaching Hubei he ordered his subordinates to organize militia training, and civilian defense corps in northern Hubei date their origin to this initiative.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年，粵匪陷武昌，土匪郭大安謀應賊，捕斬之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng Cantonese rebels took Wuchang; the local bandit Guo Da'an plotted to collaborate with the rebels and was captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianfeng (1852), when Cantonese rebels seized Wuchang, the local bandit Guo Da'an plotted to join them; Zundian captured and executed him.

sentences.zh: 三年，署按察使。

translations.literal: In the third year he served as acting provincial judicial commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xianfeng (1853) he served as acting provincial judicial commissioner.

sentences.zh: 會捻匪窺襄、樊，遵殿還襄陽籌防。

translations.literal: As Nian rebels probed Xiangyang and Fancheng, Zundian returned to Xiangyang to prepare defenses.
translations.idiomatic: When Nian rebels threatened Xiangyang and Fancheng, he returned to Xiangyang to organize the defense.

sentences.zh: 總督張亮基疏陳遵殿得民心，請提標歸其調遣。

translations.literal: Governor-general Zhang Liangji memorialized that Zundian had won the people's hearts and requested that the provincial banner troops be placed under his command.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-general Zhang Liangji memorialized that Zundian had won popular support and asked that the provincial banner troops be placed under his command.

sentences.zh: 四年，武昌再陷，皖賊竄德安、安陸、荊門，遵殿率五千人出屯王家河遏賊衝，克潛江，賜花翎。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Wuchang fell again; Anhui rebels raided De'an, Anlu, and Jingmen; Zundian led five thousand men to encamp at Wangjiahe and block the rebel thrust, recovered Qianjiang, and was awarded the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Xianfeng (1854), after Wuchang fell again and rebels from Anhui raided De'an, Anlu, and Jingmen, he led five thousand men to Wangjiahe to block their advance, recovered Qianjiang, and was awarded the peacock feather insignia.

sentences.zh: 尋破賊於京山，復其城，屢遣襄勇助總督楊霈防剿。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he defeated the rebels at Jingshan and recovered its city, and repeatedly sent Xiangyang braves to assist Governor Yang Zhe in defense and suppression.
translations.idiomatic: He soon defeated the rebels at Jingshan and recovered the city, and repeatedly dispatched Xiangyang militia to assist Governor Yang Zhe in defense and suppression.

sentences.zh: 五年春，武昌复陷，襄陽有備，賊不犯境。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifth year Wuchang was recovered and then fell again; Xiangyang was prepared and the rebels did not invade the region.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fifth year of Xianfeng (1855), Wuchang was recovered and then lost again; Xiangyang stood ready, and the rebels did not cross into his jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 六年，遷兩淮鹽運使，留湖北治糧台。
